'''Tin''' is a crafting material smelted from [[Tin Ore]] in a [[Smelter]].

Just like [[Copper Ore]], [[Tin Ore]] can only be found in the [[Black Forest]] [[Biomes|biome]]. It takes the form of small shiny rock-like deposits on the ground near water (ocean & river shorelines, or small inland lakes).

An [[Antler Pickaxe]] or better is required to mine the rocks, which yield 2-4 Tin ore each.

One Tin can be processed with two [[Copper]] on the [[Forge]] to create one [[Bronze]]. There is also an alternate recipe to craft 5 Bronze at a time given sufficient materials (10 copper, 5 tin).

'''Yellow Mushrooms''' are commonly found in [[Burial Chambers]] or [[Troll Cave]]s in the [[Black Forest]], and [[Sunken Crypts]] in the [[Swamp]].

They can be eaten raw, or used in a [[Mead Ketill]] for crafting.

As with most plants, these regrow naturally after being picked up. Picked mushrooms will respawn after 240 minutes, {{duration|14400}}. They are the ''only'' part of an underground chamber that regenerates.

[[Boar]]s will not eat Yellow Mushrooms.

'''Wolf Meat''' is a basic food source obtained by killing [[Wolf|Wolves]]. When uncooked, it may be used to make the balanced dish [[Wolf Jerky]], or the health dish [[Wolf Skewer]]. When placed on a [[Cooking Station]] or [[Iron Cooking Station]], it can be turned into '''Cooked Wolf Meat''', or [[Coal]] if left to burn. == Availability == {{drop table|title=Creature| {{drop row|item=Wolf|0star=1|1star=2|2star=4|px=50}} }} == Usage == === Crafting === * {{Item link|Cooked Wolf Meat}} * {{Item link|Coal}}, if left on a Cooking Station for too long * {{Item link|Wolf Jerky|2}} made using 1x [[Honey]] and 1x Wolf Meat * {{Item link|Wolf Skewer}} made using 1x Wolf Meat, 2x [[Mushroom]] and 1x [[Onion]] Cooked Wolf Meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Wolf Meat as ingredient. {{FoodsNav}} [[Fr:Viande_de_loup]] [[ru:Волчатина]] [[cs:Vlčí maso]]

'''Stuffed Mushroom''' is a [[Mistlands]]-tier [[food]]. == Recipe == ''Uncooked Stuffed Mushroom'' is produced in a [[Food Preparation Table]] with: * {{Item link|Blood Clot|1}} * {{Item link|Magecap|3}} * {{Item link|Turnip|2}} ''Stuffed Mushroom'' is produced by cooking Uncooked Stuffed Mushroom in a [[Stone Oven]] for 50 seconds. If left in the oven for 100 seconds, it will burn and turn into [[Coal]]. == Notes == * While Stuffed Mushroom is at the low end of the [[Mistlands]] tier of food, it is significantly easier to obtain than the better [[eitr]]-boosting foods of its tier, as it is crafted from resources which are either farmable (Magecaps and [[Turnip]]s) or easily hunted ([[Blood Clot]]s). In comparison, both [[Yggdrasil Porridge]] and [[Seeker Aspic]] require [[Royal Jelly]], which is much harder to obtain, requiring the player to venture into [[Infested Mine|Infested Mines]]. {{FoodsNav}} [[cs:Plněná houba]] [[ru:Фаршированный гриб]]
